var cv=document.getElementById('warp'),cx=cv.getContext('2d'),W,H,dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2),stars=[],lastY=scrollY,vel=0;
function mk(s){s.x=(Math.random()-.5)*2;s.y=(Math.random()-.5)*2;s.z=Math.random();s.o=Math.random()<.1;return s}
function size(){W=cv.width=innerWidth*dpr;H=cv.height=innerHeight*dpr;cv.style.width=innerWidth+'px';cv.style.height=innerHeight+'px';
  stars=[];for(var i=0;i<Math.min(260,innerWidth/4);i++)stars.push(mk({}))}
size();addEventListener('resize',size);
function warp(){
  cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  var sy=scrollY;vel+=(Math.abs(sy-lastY)-vel)*.12;lastY=sy;
  var sp=RM?0:.0016+Math.min(vel,80)*.0011,ox=W/2+mx*-80*dpr,oy=H*.4+my*-60*dpr,F=Math.max(W,H)*.55;
  for(var i=0;i<stars.length;i++){
    var s=stars[i],pz=s.z;s.z-=sp;
    if(s.z<=.02){mk(s);s.z=1;pz=1.02}
    var px=ox+s.x/pz*F*.5,py=oy+s.y/pz*F*.5,qx=ox+s.x/s.z*F*.5,qy=oy+s.y/s.z*F*.5;
    if(qx<0||qx>W||qy<0||qy>H){mk(s);s.z=1;continue}
    var a=Math.min(1,(1-s.z)*1.3+.1);
    cx.strokeStyle=s.o?'rgba(255,0,127,'+a+')':'rgba(0,240,255,'+a*.68+')';
    cx.lineWidth=(s.o?1.8:1.1)*dpr*(1.2-s.z);
    cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(px,py);cx.lineTo(qx+(RM?dpr:0),qy);cx.stroke();
  }
}
